resources.string: Maintains high-priority listening for payment receipt SMS.
Matching bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, and Cellfin payment receipts.

With your consent, GressPay monitors incoming payment confirmation SMS for bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay, and Cellfin. It parses sender rail, amount, and TrxID — personal messages and full inbox data are never uploaded or stored. Data is delivered securely over TLS to your GressPay platform to automate order settlements.
Toggle off matching or clear credentials at any time to immediately suspend automated sync.
